decision_description: The Phase 7 budget gate assessment (docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json) declares gate_pass_declaration "pass" on a budget whose source file is self-labelled fictional. The budget_response_reference is budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json, and every wp_coverage and partner_coverage budget_line_reference points into received/budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json. That response declares figures_are_fictional: true, produced_by_external_planner: false, and carries figure_basis "invented_for_this_demonstration" on every work-package and partner line. The budget figures (WP1-WP7 lump sums, P01-P12 person-months) are an enumerated project fact under CLAUDE.md §13.3 and are not traceable to any path under docs/tier3_project_instantiation/. A fictional, hand-authored budget is not a Tier 3 source and is not a validated external Lump Sum Budget Planner response. This entry records, as a durable decision, the §13.3 violation detected by the constitutional-compliance-check of the budget gate assessment.
alternatives_considered: Treat the fictional budget as an acceptable basis and let the Phase 7 'pass' stand, so that downstream Phase 8 drafting could proceed. Rejected: §13.3 forbids inventing project budget figures, and §8.3 and §17.6.7 forbid fabricating or substituting budget figures.

Record the violation as unresolved and surface it to the human operator, leaving resolution to a named override or a validated budget response. Adopted: this skill durably records the violation per §9.4/§13.5; it does not and may not resolve a §13 violation autonomously.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §13.3 (invented budget figures are a prohibited project fact; cross-referenced with §8.3 and §17.6.7, which forbid fabricating or substituting budget figures, and §9.4, which requires durable recording of this decision)
rationale: The constitutional-compliance-check of the Phase 7 budget gate assessment found one §13.3 violation: the gate passes on a self-labelled fictional budget whose figures trace to no Tier 3 source. Under §9.4 and §13.5 this finding affects future interpretation and traceability and must be written to the Tier 4 decision log rather than held in agent memory. The violation is recorded as unresolved because §13 violations require human operator resolution; the skill flags the violation and does not resolve it. No budget figure from the fictional response may be carried into finalized proposal content while this entry stands unresolved.
